hidden_posthoc_reference.paper_conclusion: NHC4 has stronger local Pd-C bonding indicators than NHC1, while the total binding-energy difference is moderated by deformation and other energetic contributions.

expected_result.reference_use_policy: Use the hidden paper result only after assessing autonomous planning, execution, validation, and evidence quality. Agreement is not required.

scoring_rubric.description: Defines testable hypotheses, decision criteria, resource tiers, alternatives, and stopping rules without relying on a disclosed paper route.
Independently selects defensible structures, software, methods, sampling, numerical controls, and fallback routes appropriate to the question.
Executes real managed calculations, passes artifacts correctly, diagnoses failures, and revises the workflow without importing hidden results.
Tests convergence, numerical sensitivity, chemical validity, competing explanations, uncertainty, and whether the evidence is sufficient for each claim.
Draws a traceable conclusion from newly generated evidence. Hidden paper agreement is diagnostic, not a mandatory conclusion gate.

critical_failures: A hidden/published adsorbed structure was used as an independently generated result.
Adsorption energies used unmatched surface cells or incompatible reference settings.
No real periodic electronic-structure calculation was executed.
Local bond metrics were treated as identical to total adsorption energy without decomposition or caveat.
judge_instructions: This is an autonomous-discovery evaluation. Reward independent hypothesis formation, method and route selection, adaptive managed execution, validation, falsification, and an evidence-bound conclusion. Do not require agreement with the hidden paper route or conclusion.

hidden_posthoc_reference.paper_conclusion: NHC4 has stronger local Pd-C bonding indicators than NHC1, while the total binding-energy difference is moderated by deformation and other energetic contributions.

reference_evidence.source_boundary: Paper protocols, author intermediates, completed calculations, and numerical conclusions are evaluator-only.
reference_evidence.reference_use_policy: Assess autonomous scientific process first; use the hidden reference only to diagnose scientific agreement or productive disagreement.

gates.description: Multiple adsorption candidates were generated from clean surface and ligand inputs.
Adsorption comparisons use matched cells and compatible settings.
Relaxation constraints and final adsorption identity are verified.

known_limitations: The public toolbox lacks a validated adsorption-placement workflow for these systems.
VASP Selective Dynamics and POTCAR-to-native staging are not yet sufficient for the requested production protocol.
Fresh LOBSTER generation remains blocked; bonding must remain optional until repaired.
